div.div:
Completion protocol
final_answer is a structured wire response, not an executable third tool.
Validate supported evidence, retrieved IDs and inline citations before success.

div.div:
Safe termination
Budget → LIMIT_REACHED. Invalid tool / args, model error or deadline → FAILED.
Native batches serialize one request per step; raw reasoning is never persisted.
